change_summary: Added a three-window loss taxonomy audit that clusters accepted-stack losers into reproducible mechanism/family buckets and measures winner collateral if a future fix zeroes a family.
hypothesis: Current accepted-stack losses cluster into reproducible failure families that can be counted without changing strategy logic.
notes: Artifact: data/exp_20260425_038_loss_taxonomy.json. Cross-window repeated fine-grain families were two reduced-risk Technology trend loser sleeves with zero winner collateral; coarse mechanism rollup showed trend_instant_failure (7 losses, 24.28% of gross losses, zero winners to protect) as the cleanest repeated bad-trade source. Trend losses dominate 23/31 audited losses; archived news coverage is missing on nearly all losses and entry-day LLM archive presence is 0/31, so LLM/news explanation remains a measurement gap rather than a rejected mechanism.
